name: Nexus Dragon Sentinel
text:
2+ 'Nexus' Monsters
If this card is sent to the GY by an opponent's card effect you can banish up to 4 Cyberse monsters from your GY Including this card, then Special Summon a Link Monster with a link rating that equals the number of cards banished (This is treated as a Link Summon.) During the turn this card was Link Summoned it can make an Attack for each 'Nexus' Link Monster in the Banished Zone.
